cards.text: I read the manuscript through and set it down. Then I told Hoke plainly that it was no good, and had him sit at the typewriter.
Hoke is a friend, and this pamphlet is his League's work. Saying straight out that it is badly argued costs me something, and the hour is late.
The pages lie fanned across the desk just under the lamp. I set my hand flat on the top sheet and keep it there.
I feel settled, with a thin edge of regret. The cigarette in the ashtray has burned down to nothing while I talked.
